description: This Java source file defines the class EtbTestSequence, which manages a sequence of commands to test electronic throttle control. It includes UI components, scheduling logic, and interactions with sensors and command queues.

classes.name: EtbTestSequence
classes.description: Main class orchestrating the ETB test sequence, including UI button and scheduled commands.

methods.name: EtbTestSequence
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the button action to start the sequence.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns the JButton used to initiate the ETB test sequence.

classes.name: EtbTarget
classes.description: Inner static class representing a target throttle position with a scheduled duration and a link to the next target.

methods.name: EtbTarget
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the target with duration and position.

methods.name: addNext
methods.description: Creates and links the next EtbTarget in the sequence.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to set the throttle position and schedules the next target if available.
